report_metadata.title: CloudTrace AI - Data Quality & Validation Report

missing_values_explanation.version: 23 events are operational events (incidents, config changes, traffic spikes, autoscaling) which naturally do not have software version tags; only deployments have version tags.

events.sort_correction_applied: Sorted by timestamp (stable sort) moving out-of-order 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z event to the correct chronological index.

metrics.time_grid_completeness: 336 hours * 8 services = 2688 records. Exactly 1 reading per service per hour.

costs.sparse_line_item_semantics: object-storage Storage-Egress appears only during active transfer window (2026-03-07T11:00 to 2026-03-08T07:00, 21 records), exactly mirroring real AWS S3 / Cloud Billing usage exports.

anomalies_preservation_attestation.statement: All high-magnitude telemetry spikes (CPU up to 97.6%, requests up to 55,336, DB queries up to 55,336, egress network up to 2,094 MB, costs up to $14.71/hr) have been strictly preserved as legitimate cloud behavioral signals.

scenario_1_normal_baseline.name: Normal Operation Baseline
scenario_1_normal_baseline.description: Baseline system telemetry with realistic diurnal cycles across all 8 services. No anomaly alerts.

scenario_2_order_api_traffic_spike.name: Order API Traffic Spike
scenario_2_order_api_traffic_spike.trigger_event: Marketing flash sale campaign launched globally
scenario_2_order_api_traffic_spike.cost_impact: Proportional increase in api-gateway API-Requests and Gateway-DataTransfer costs.

scenario_3_database_query_explosion.name: Database Query Explosion
scenario_3_database_query_explosion.trigger_event: Deploy personalized recommendation feed with real-time similarity query (v1.8.0)
scenario_3_database_query_explosion.mitigation_event: Rollback similarity query loop and restore cached precomputations (v1.8.1)

scenario_4_network_traffic_spike.name: Network Traffic Spike / Egress Surge
scenario_4_network_traffic_spike.trigger_event: Updated invoice PDF generator to attach high-resolution uncompressed assets
scenario_4_network_traffic_spike.mitigation_event: Re-enabled PDF compression and S3 presigned asset caching

scenario_5_problematic_deployment.name: Problematic Deployment & Memory Leak Autoscale
scenario_5_problematic_deployment.trigger_event: Release checkout optimization and inventory pre-fetch (v2.4.0)
scenario_5_problematic_deployment.mitigation_event: Emergency hotfix rollback: Revert v2.4.0 checkout pre-fetch memory leak (v2.4.1)

scenario_6_storage_growth.name: Storage Growth Accumulation
scenario_6_storage_growth.trigger_event: Enable detailed JSON audit logging & lifecycle policy disabled
scenario_6_storage_growth.cost_impact: Cumulative steady increase in Standard-Storage line items.

scenario_7_multiple_simultaneous_anomali.name: Multiple Simultaneous Anomalies & Cascade
scenario_7_multiple_simultaneous_anomali.trigger_event: Regional flash promo surge in EU/US regions + Redis memory fragmentation and eviction thrashing
scenario_7_multiple_simultaneous_anomali.cost_impact: Redis node scale-out cost increase from $0.26/hr to $0.39/hr and postgres IOPS burst increase.

scenario_8_false_positive.name: Harmless Telemetry Anomaly / False Positive
trigger_events: Scheduled routine database maintenance: autovacuum analyze and index rebuilding
Upstream third-party banking gateway latency degradation

cost_impact.cost_divergence_explained: High CPU on postgres-db due to internal autovacuum did not increase provisioned instance or IOPS costs. High latency and errors on payment-service due to 3rd-party banking partner did not consume additional compute units ($0.081/hr flat). Demonstrates CloudTrace AI must not equate high telemetry alarms directly to cost root causes.

warnings: raw/events.csv had 1 row (object-storage volume alert at 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z) recorded at index 23 out of chronological sequence before March 11 events. Chronological sorting corrected this in processed/events_clean.csv.

raw/costs.csv has 21 records for object-storage Storage-Egress corresponding to the high-res uncompressed assets event on March 7-8. These records were preserved without fabricating zero-cost rows, maintaining genuine cloud billing CUR semantics.
